title: Ivo and the Choir
author: Silas Ashgrove
blurb: Tamsin Nakamura, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
